title: Buzzing bass

complaints.says: There's a buzz in the speakers whenever I'm plugged in.

win.label: No hum in the mains
win.hint: Press Ground Lift on the bass DI.

hints: Probe the bass channel. What's on it besides the bass?
cause: A ground loop between the bass rig and the sound system was adding hum at the DI.
lesson: Hum that comes and goes with one instrument is usually a ground loop. The DI's Ground Lift switch breaks the loop without touching the audio.
